title: Grow Garlic in Plastic Bottles Water Method Edges
reason: Describes a method for growing garlic at home using plastic bottles.

tasks.task: Describe the initial steps of preparing the garlic and plastic bottles for planting.

subtasks.text: Observe the process of removing the skin and slightly peeling the top part of garlic bulbs.
Note the action of taking plastic bottles, cutting them, and filling them with water.

tasks.task: Explain how to place the garlic in the prepared plastic bottles.

subtasks.text: Watch as the garlic is placed one by one on top of each hole in the plastic bottle.
Notice the process of pouring water to submerge the bottom part of the garlic.

tasks.task: Describe the growth and transformation of the garlic over time.

subtasks.text: Observe the garlic starting to sprout after five days.
Note the completed plant with well-developed roots and leaves after about 15 days.

tasks.task: Explain the final steps in the garlic growing process.

subtasks.text: Watch as the plants are separated and replanted.
Pay attention to the instruction about maintaining a distance of three to four inches between the plants.
Observe the final statement about the garlic plant requiring proper care to produce a mature bulb.
